body:
### Problem

After installing Neovim on Kali Linux, random characters such as:
+q4D73
appeared before the first line of files and even on Neovim's startup
screen.

Example:
+q4D73#!/bin/python

instead of:
#!/bin/python

The issue occurred only in Neovim and only when running inside
QTerminal.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Open QTerminal 2.4.0.

2. Verify:

   echo $TERM

   Output:

   xterm-256color

3. Start Neovim with no user configuration and manually load the OSC52 runtime plugin:

   nvim -u NONE --cmd "runtime plugin/osc52.lua"

4. Observe that garbage characters appear on the startup screen, for example:

   +q4D73

5. Verify that Neovim starts normally without the OSC52 plugin:

   nvim -u NONE

   No garbage characters appear.

6. Additional investigation showed that the issue disappears when:

   /usr/share/nvim/runtime/plugin/osc52.lua

   is disabled.

7. Running xterm instead of QTerminal does not reproduce the issue.

### Expected behavior

Neovim should start normally without displaying terminal response data or unexpected characters on the startup screen.

Loading the built-in OSC52 runtime plugin should not cause terminal capability responses to be displayed or interpreted as user input.

Actual behavior:

Garbage characters such as:

+q4D73

appear on the startup screen before any file content is processed.

The issue appears only when osc52.lua is loaded and only in QTerminal.

### Nvim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.12.3 Build type: Release LuaJIT 2.1.1761786044

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

vim behaves normally 

### Operating system/version

kali linux VERSION="2026.3"

### Terminal name/version

qterminal 2.4.0

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

sudo apt install neovim

comment_data.body:
****Warning**: I found the solution with the help of AI, I just wanted to help if somebody will face the same issue.**


**FIX**

Root cause:

The issue is caused by Neovim's built-in OSC52 runtime plugin:

    /usr/share/nvim/runtime/plugin/osc52.lua

When Neovim starts inside QTerminal, osc52.lua performs terminal
capability detection using terminal queries and TermResponse
autocommands.

QTerminal responds with terminal escape sequences that are partially
interpreted as input by Neovim, resulting in garbage characters such as:

    +q4D73

and

    1;2c

appearing on the startup screen and before file contents.

======================================================================

RECOMMENDED FIX

Add the following to the TOP of:

    ~/.config/nvim/init.lua

---------------------------------------------------------------
vim.g.termfeatures = {
  osc52 = false,
}
---------------------------------------------------------------

This uses the built-in disable mechanism present in osc52.lua and
prevents the OSC52 feature detection code from running.

After saving the file, restart Neovim:

    nvim

======================================================================

WORKAROUND

If the configuration-based solution does not work, disable the plugin
directly:

    sudo mv \
    /usr/share/nvim/runtime/plugin/osc52.lua \
    /usr/share/nvim/runtime/plugin/osc52.lua.disabled

Restart Neovim:

    nvim

The garbage characters should disappear completely.

======================================================================

VERIFICATION

Problematic command:

    nvim -u NONE --cmd "runtime plugin/osc52.lua"

Result:

    +q4D73 appears

After disabling osc52.lua:

    nvim

Result:

    No garbage characters appear

======================================================================

STATUS

Confirmed affected environment:

    OS: Kali Linux
    Terminal: QTerminal 2.4.0
    TERM=xterm-256color
    Neovim: v0.12.3

Confirmed not affected:

    xterm

Minimal reproducer:

    nvim -u NONE --cmd "runtime plugin/osc52.lua"

Minimal workaround:

    Disable osc52.lua or set:

    vim.g.termfeatures = {
      osc52 = false,
    }

before Neovim loads the runtime plugin.

> I just wanted to help if somebody will face the same issue.

That's appreciated.

But this is discussed in many other closed issues, so I am closing this one.

title: NEOVIM GARBAGE CHARACTERS (+q4D73) IN QTERMINAL INVESTIGATION REPORT
